- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:265-289 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: When reconcile detects any rejected change, authorized created files remain quarantined instead of being restored.
  WHY: The restore logic runs only when `not rejected`, so a mixed attempt loses legitimate files and causes retries to start without them; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this BLOCKER while qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it MAJOR.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:254-257 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The hidden-path classification exempts only `.github`, rejecting legitimate tracked hidden directories including `.ai/` and `.claude/`.
  WHY: Changes to tracked pipeline and runtime-managed dotfiles are classified as unauthorized, causing reconciliation to fail with exit 20 and downstream retries.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:954-958 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `INTEGRATION_BRANCH_NAME` is stripped by `env -i` before `verify_integration_fingerprints.py` receives it.
  WHY: Baseline-state captures and operator logs show `branch=` instead of the actual branch name; the verifier remains functionally correct because the value is metadata only.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8977-8980 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `INTEGRATION_BRANCH_NAME` is stripped by `env -i` before the poller verifier receives it.
  WHY: Fingerprint verification and baseline-state logs show `branch=` instead of the actual integration branch name; the verifier remains functionally correct because the value is metadata only.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:213-221 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_move_to_quarantine` leaves empty parent directories in the workspace after moving rejected files or directory trees.
  WHY: Subsequent inventories capture stale directories as created entries, causing inconsistent manifest deltas and unnecessary quarantine round-trips.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:271-279 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When reconcile finds any rejected change, the entire `created_roots` set stays in quarantine — authorized regular files that the model legitimately created are not restored.
  WHY: A CSRF attack payload that plants both `sitecustomize.py` and `valid_helper.py` in the same attempt succeeds in denying the valid file; the model then retries, and the quarantined valid file is permanently lost.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:256-257 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hidden-path classification exempts only `.github` from the dotfile rejection.
  WHY: Every other hidden path, including `.claude/hooks/`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.ai/review_runtime/`, `.events/`, `.worktrees/`, `.gitignore`, `.editorconfig`, and `.gitattributes`, is classified as `hidden-path` and rejected.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:954-958 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `INTEGRATION_BRANCH_NAME="${INTEGRATION_BRANCH_NAME:-${TARGET_BRANCH:-}}"` is set as a shell command prefix before invoking `run_resolver_validator_python`, but `untrusted_process_sandbox.sh` runs `env -i` and strips it.
  WHY: `verify_integration_fingerprints.py` receives the empty-string default, replacing the real branch name in operational log lines with `branch=`.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8977-8980 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The poller sets `INTEGRATION_BRANCH_NAME="${integration_branch}"` as a command prefix before invoking `run_poller_isolated_python`, but `untrusted_process_sandbox.sh` runs `env -i` and strips it.
  WHY: The integration judge path loses the branch name in fingerprint verification and baseline-state logs.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: From the linked issue — "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line: the re-audit checks sibling code paths (other venues, adapters, handlers, workers) for the same defect and re-opens the loop if any remain." And from the issue summary — "preserve authorized new files."
  Expected change site: scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py reconcile() — the restore loop at lines 271-279.
  Evidence of absence: The current implementation at lines 271-279 gates the restoration of ALL created roots on the absence of ANY rejection (`if not rejected:`). There is no code path that filters `created_roots` to restore only the subset not covered by rejected entries. The test suite covers only single-rejection (`test_workspace_guard_quarantines_ignored_python_startup_payload` — one bad file) and single-authorized (`test_workspace_guard_restores_authorized_new_regular_file` — one good file) paths. `test_every_writer_path_reconciles_complete_workspace_manifest` asserts snapshot/reconcile call presence but not survival of authorized files after a mixed rejection. The mixed authorized-plus-rejected case is untested and the implementation drops valid work.
  Severity: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, lines 271-279 — Restore only non-rejected created roots when rejected is non-empty, rather than dropping all created files. Estimated lines changed: 6.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5

- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, line 256 — Add `.claude` and `.ai` to the hidden-path exemption set alongside `.github`, so tracked pipeline dotfile directories survive reconciliation. Estimated lines changed: 2.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`, lines 954-958 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, lines 8977-8980 — Pass `INTEGRATION_BRANCH_NAME` through the sandbox as a command-line argument to `verify_integration_fingerprints.py` rather than as a shell environment-variable prefix. Estimated lines changed: 4.
